Subject: Supplier payment configuration + UAT remittance confirmation

Hi Lydia / FurnishCo team —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for the upcoming pilot. To finish vendor onboarding on our side we need three quick items so finance can schedule the first test remittance and map POs correctly:

1) A signed W-9 (or equivalent tax doc) for FurnishCo (we can accept a scanned PDF).
2) Bank confirmation letter or ACH/Wire details (bank letter or bank-signed template is preferred).
3) A 1–2 line sample of your preferred remittance string for us to include on the test transfer (how you want the invoice/PO number to appear on the beneficiary statement).

If you can drop those here or via DocuSign today, finance will schedule a micro-deposit and a single $1.00 UAT wire next week to verify routing and remittance parsing.

Notes about PO mapping: our system expects a PO reference in the remittance text in the format PO:##### or PO-#####. If FurnishCo uses a different scheme we can add a mapping rule but we’ll need a sample of 8–12 invoices so our parser can be tuned.

I’ve looped in Jordan (operations) for PO mapping and Marissa (payments) for the finance side.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Lydia —

Received, thanks for the quick turnaround and for attaching examples. A couple quick operational asks so we don’t hit any surprises in UAT: 

1) Marissa, can you confirm whether finance requires the bank letter to include a specific phrase ("account verified by bank") or whether the signed bank letter FurnishCo sent is sufficient?
2) Jordan, when you ingest the remit-sample.csv, please add a mapping rule to accept both INV:{invoice_number} and PO:{po_number} patterns and mark "CLIENT:FurnishCo" as a customer tag so our reconciliation engine picks it up. We should stage the mapping in the sandbox before running the UAT wire.
3) Lydia / FurnishCo — can you confirm the beneficiary name exactly as it should appear on the wire? The bank letter lists "FurnishCo Inc." but your invoices sometimes use "FurnishCo". If the name differs the bank may flag the UAT.

If we get confirmations by EOD we’ll schedule a micro-deposit attempt for Friday 05/22 and a $1 UAT wire on Monday 05/25 (if sandbox parse looks clean).

Ben
